breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting boundary conditions. The original prompt incorrectly specified both Neumann and Dirichlet conditions for the same boundaries. The ground truth correctly removed the conflicting Dirichlet condition. The agent, however, repeated both contradictory conditions in its generated specification.
